# UX & UI Best Practices

> A living, principle-first reference for building interfaces people love to use — across mobile web, PWAs, online shops, desktop, web, and conversational/bot UIs. It is both a written guideline and a runnable code showcase.

This repo is organized along two axes — **archetypes** (what you're building) and **platforms** (where it runs) — plus craft topics (principles, UI, patterns, techniques) and actionable checklists. Agents should read the relevant guideline before implementing UI. Start with AGENTS.md for the operating rules.

## Start here (for agents)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): UX/UI operating rules and non-negotiable defaults for AI agents.
- [Docs index](docs/README.md): the full map of the reference.
- [Entry template](docs/_TEMPLATE.md): the shape and front-matter of every guideline.

## Principles (why)
- [Feedback for every action](docs/principles/feedback-for-every-action.md): every action needs an immediate, visible response.
- [Principles index](docs/principles/README.md): timeless UX/UI laws.

## UI craft (look)
- [Type scale & readability](docs/ui/type-scale-and-readability.md): a small, consistent type system; body ≥ 16px on mobile.
- [UI index](docs/ui/README.md): typography, color, spacing, motion, components.

## Patterns (behavior)
- [Patterns index](docs/patterns/README.md): reusable solutions to recurring interaction problems.

## Techniques (feel)
- [Skeleton loading](docs/techniques/skeleton-loading.md): layout-shaped placeholders beat blank spinners.
- [Techniques index](docs/techniques/README.md): perceived-performance and smoothness techniques.

## Archetypes (what you're building)
- [Ops / admin panel](docs/archetypes/ops-admin-panel.md): power users — density, tables, keyboard, bulk actions.
- [Consumer mobile app](docs/archetypes/consumer-mobile-app.md): non-technical users — simplicity, guidance, forgiveness.
- [Fancy app](docs/archetypes/fancy-app.md): few features, high polish and delight.
- [E-commerce](docs/archetypes/ecommerce.md): trust and conversion — find, decide, buy.
- [Conversational / bot](docs/archetypes/conversational-bot.md): chat & assistant UIs — turn-taking, affordance, trust.
- [Game app](docs/archetypes/game-app.md): players — feedback, flow, reward loops (early).
- [Archetypes index](docs/archetypes/README.md): how to use archetype playbooks.

## Platforms (where it runs)
- [Platforms index](docs/platforms/README.md): mobile web, PWA, desktop, web constraints.

## Checklists (ship it)
- [Mobile UX checklist](docs/checklists/mobile-ux-checklist.md): pre-ship pass for mobile screens.
- [Checklists index](docs/checklists/README.md): actionable lists.

## Code
- [Showcases](showcases/README.md): runnable single-technique demos (standalone HTML).
- [Playground](playground/README.md): interactive React gallery to explore demos live.
- [Prototypes](prototypes/README.md): complete sample React apps demonstrating a whole style/archetype.
